result.summary: Found 2 issues: a missing localization string shown as a raw key, and a restaurant name clipped by the card edge in the fastest-near-you row.

issues.description: The popular restaurants section heading displays the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and verify translations are loaded for this locale.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word at the card edge, not just the last carousel item peeking off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or truncate with an ellipsis so the name remains readable within the card.
